text.p: The stocks of EMC Corp and Silicon Graphics Inc were trading lower than their closing prices on the New York Stock Exchange during the after-hours session, dealers said Thursday.
EMC was at 35 against a close of 39, while Silicon was at 14 against 17, they said.
The two companies reported earnings that came in line or lower than estimates set out by First Call's consensus among analysts.
EMC reported first-quarter earnings of $0.44 a share against $0.35 for the same period last year. First Call had $0.44 for the period.
Meanwhile, Silicon came out with a third-quarter profit of $0.06 a share after charges against $0.31 for the same period a year ago. It said the latest quarter figure was $0.09 before the charges.
The figure came much lower than First Call's estimate $0.27.
